PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 16, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Susana Gonzalez Edmond, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Josh LaFarga, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 927 4212 9521
  https://www.longbeach.gov/lbcd/planning/commission/

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53362  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53363  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, May 2, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-53365  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-24-031; and approve
  modification (MOD23-019) to a previously approved Conditional Use Permit (App.
  No. 0804-25), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto,
  for the addition of a 386-square-foot outdoor patio dining area to expand the

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MAY 16, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  existing service area for on-site alcohol sales of beer, wine and distilled spirits at an
  existing restaurant with a fixed bar located at 3229 East Anaheim Street within the
  Community – Automobile Oriented (CCA) Zoning District. (District 2)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-53361  Recommendation to determine that the project as modified is within the scope of
  the project previously analyzed as part of the Downtown Plan Program
  Environmental Impact Report (PEIR) (State Clearinghouse No. 2009071006) and
  Downtown Plan PEIR Addendum (EIRA06-20) and warrants no further
  environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines Section 15162; adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval,
  including application of the Downtown Plan PEIR Mitigation, Monitoring and
  Reporting Plan, related thereto; and

  Approve a modification (Mod23-020) to a Site Plan Review (SPR 20-045) for a new
  8-story, 140-unit, residential building, including two levels of parking providing 80
  parking spaces, 60 bicycle parking spaces, 2,452 square feet of
  commercial/retail/amenity space, and 10,326 square feet of common and private
  open space areas on a site currently developed with a commercial/office building
  and surface parking located at 937-957 Pine Avenue and 120 West 10th Street in
  the Downtown (PD-30) Plan. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-53370  Recommendation to conduct a study session on the Downtown Plan (PD30)
  Update including information on the planning process to date and the upcoming
  Community Open House that will take place on May 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
